title: Coronary sinus devices
scope: Generic class mechanism in representative anatomy. The anatomy, device shape and positions shown are representative of this class; they are not measured on a specific patient or population, and not a specific product. Schematic, not to scale; poses do not predict clinical fit, deformation, performance or flow.
stageLabel: Schematic · representative anatomy · not to scale
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Locate the treatment region
views.lesson: Use the highlighted region to orient the enlarged views.

views.label: Coronary sinus and chambers
views.title: Follow the coronary sinus into the right atrium
views.lesson: Seen from behind, the coronary sinus runs in the groove between the left atrium and left ventricle, then opens into the right atrium near the inferior vena cava. The chambers come from a real heart model with walls added. The coronary sinus is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population.

views.label: Mechanism section
views.title: See the tissue–device relationship
views.lesson: Trace the open channel through the narrow middle of the scaffold.

views.label: Oblique detail
views.title: Understand depth and attachment
views.lesson: An oblique view separates the near surface, device and supporting tissue.

views.label: Face view
views.title: Look along the opening
views.lesson: The face view complements the section. All poses and proportions are representative, not measured.

location.label: TREATMENT LOCATION
location.body: The highlighted region locates this class in the heart. The marker is enlarged for orientation.

wall.label: CORONARY SINUS
wall.body: This venous segment represents the coronary sinus, outside the chambers in the atrioventricular groove.

waist.label: NARROW CENTRAL CHANNEL
waist.body: The waist is visibly narrower than the ends. The illustration does not calculate pressure or perfusion.

ends.label: FLARED ENDS
ends.body: The generic scaffold opens against the illustrated vessel wall. Contact is representative, not computed.

region_CS.label: CORONARY SINUS
region_CS.body: This venous channel lies outside the left chambers in the groove between atrium and ventricle.

region_RA.label: RIGHT ATRIUM
region_RA.body: The coronary sinus drains into the right atrium. Its opening and course are representative, drawn for orientation.

region_LA.label: LEFT ATRIUM
region_LA.body: The left atrium sits above the groove that carries the coronary sinus.

region_LV.label: LEFT VENTRICLE
region_LV.body: The left ventricle sits below the groove that carries the coronary sinus.

region_RV.label: RIGHT VENTRICLE
region_RV.body: The underside of the right ventricle shows below the right atrium.

region_device.label: GENERIC SCAFFOLD
region_device.body: The generic scaffold sits inside the opened coronary sinus. Its size and position are representative.
